description: A portfolio CONFIGURATION, not a copy of the profile. This is the core rule of the system: adapting a portfolio for a job must NEVER mutate profiles or projects. A portfolio document therefore stores only a template choice, section toggles and ORDERING (arrays of ids/keys). Content is resolved from profiles + projects at render time. A user may hold many portfolios (drafts, published, one per job); only one may be published under a given username at a time.

username.description: DENORMALISED from users.username. Deliberate duplication: the public route /portfolio/:username must resolve in ONE indexed read with no join to users. Backend must rewrite this on every username change.

name.description: Internal label, e.g. 'Java Developer Portfolio'. Not shown publicly.

templateId.description: REFERENCE -> portfolioTemplates._id. Templates are shared across all users, so referencing is mandatory.

templateKey.description: DENORMALISED portfolioTemplates.templateKey so the public renderer can pick a React component without a second query.

sourceJobAnalysisId.description: REFERENCE -> jobAnalyses._id. null = generic portfolio. Non-null = this portfolio was adapted for that specific opportunity.

sections.description: EMBEDDED fixed-key toggle map, matching the /builder checkboxes exactly.

sectionOrder.description: Optional custom render order. Empty/absent = the default order in lib/enums.js PORTFOLIO_SECTIONS.

orderedSkills.description: ORDERING ONLY - normalizedName values pointing into profiles.skills. Job-relevant skills first. No skill data is copied, so editing the profile instantly updates every portfolio.

orderedProjects.description: ORDERING ONLY - REFERENCES -> projects._id, recommended projects first. Renderer must drop ids that are deleted or have includeInPortfolio: false.

headlineOverride.description: Optional job-specific headline. Overrides profiles.professionalTitle for THIS portfolio only - the profile itself stays untouched.

summaryOverride.description: Optional job-specific About text. Same non-destructive principle as headlineOverride.

theme.description: Per-portfolio visual overrides on top of the template defaults. The surface colours below back the builder's Custom template, which is how a user gets their own palette WITHOUT the platform ever accepting uploaded CSS.

backgroundColor.description: Page background. The hex pattern is the sanitisation boundary - an arbitrary string here could otherwise become a CSS injection.

resumeId.description: REFERENCE -> resumes._id. Backs the public 'Download CV' button.

isPublished.description: Only one document per username may have isPublished: true (enforced by a partial unique index, see indexes/indexes.js).

viewCount.description: Incremented with $inc on public views. Never read on the hot path.
